Lugou Bridge is located in 15 kilometers southwest of Beijing. It was built in 1189 and has more than 800 years history. There are many stone lions on the bridge with different beautiful shapes, so people say the lions on Lugou Bridge cannot be counted. The bridge is famous for its building art and also important because the Lugou Bridge Incident happened there in 1937.
